Team —

Quick summary: Harmonix AI (prospect deal HWX-2026-8910, target ARR $420k/year) is asking for a one-time exception: 60-day extension to their POC window and an additional 250k free token-credit allowance (they say their tests consume tokens faster than expected because they are running long-context multimodal prompts). Procurement needs a written approval by COB Wednesday to keep the Q4 procurement cadence intact.

What we have:
- Product: integration with our streaming API is complete; customer reports stable latency and KV cache savings in internal evals.
- Business case: they are an enterprise healthcare analytics provider (PHI-sensitive pipeline). Closing probability (per AE) ~60% if we can support a longer POC with compliance evidence.
- Risk: 250k credits is materially above our PLG cushion. Customer requests billing hold during the extended run until they sign SOW.

Ask:
1) Exec signoff for a one-time 60-day extension (non-recurring)
2) Approve up to 250,000 complimentary token credits for the extended window OR approve a temporary billing hold with milestone-based credit release (whichever you prefer)
3) Legal to prepare a short addendum that limits exposure and requires milestone evidence (logs, eval prompts) to unlock additional credits

Attachments: proposed addendum + SOW draft + procurement thread.

If we can do a partial approval (e.g., 30 days + 100k credits) that would also be helpful — we can escalate to Jonas for the remainder. Need an answer before 2026-11-03 17:00 PT.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan

Tessa —

Thanks for the summary. A few clarifying points before I recommend escalation:
1) Is the 250k figure all token credits, or a mix of credits + discounted overage? Please confirm exact SKU breakdown (generation vs embeddings).
2) Does the customer require an unconditional billing hold, or are they open to milestone-controlled unlocks? Milestone unlocks significantly reduce our risk.
3) Are there any red flags in the SOW draft around data residency or export controls (they mentioned PHI). If so, Legal needs to weigh in.

My initial comfort band: we can approve up to 100k complimentary tokens and a 30-day extension without VP signoff if Legal signs the addendum and Finance countersigns a billing-hold plan. Anything larger — needs Jonas. If the customer will accept milestone gating (e.g., 50% of extra credits released after completion of security checklist + SOC evidence), that would be preferred.

If you can get the customer's agreement to milestone-based release, I can approve the billing hold mechanics and get Finance to create a temporary ledger flag. Otherwise, please loop Jonas for exec signoff.
